svg.text: Locating rim, retainer section and all retainer positions
All dimensions in mm. Nominal model dimensions.
Section through a bottom hook (actual STL section)
X = 21.87; horizontal axis points inward from panel edge.
Hook polygon (outward offset d, height Z), before R0.15 blends:
d = 0 on outer rim wall; Z = 0 on plate underside.
Hook centers, measured from panel origin
Panel origin: lower-left, X right, Y up.
Rounded section is authoritative; polygon intersections define the blend construction dimensions.
